}

}
state-dbnative-state
{

}
acpacp

tui-gateway
Transport

A dangerous command awaits the user's decision.
Schema fidelity
{"payload":"exact","result":"exact","carrier":"structural","limitations":["Contract models are enforced at dispatch for unknown params keys only; production logs, rather than rejects, a result or payload that violates its model, so runtime captures remain the occurrence authority.","OpenModel payloads (additionalProperties true) admit producer-owned fields that the contract does not enumerate.","Contract declarations establish legal shape and existence, not runtime reachability.","The carrier is the JSON-RPC frame as the stdio census records it; the census marks its own outbound frames with direction \"client\"."]}

Replaces the 0.20.0 approval.request event; the client answers with a JSON-RPC response frame, and the legacy approval.respond method remains beside it. The id is srq-<12 hex>. Per the release source (not captured), every attached client receives the frame and the first response settles it. Puppeteer never answers: the native TUI does.

{"payload":"exact","result":"exact","carrier":"structural","limitations":["Contract models are enforced at dispatch for unknown params keys only; production logs, rather than rejects, a result or payload that violates its model, so runtime captures remain the occurrence authority.","OpenModel payloads (additionalProperties true) admit producer-owned fields that the contract does not enumerate.","Contract declarations establish legal shape and existence, not runtime reachability.","The carrier is the JSON-RPC frame as the stdio census records it; the census marks its own outbound frames with direction \"client\"."]}

Trigger
Whole-session branch of a stored parent: the owning backend reads and copies the transcript, which never crosses the wire (a separate method so an older gateway fails loudly, not with an empty branch).

Channel
tui-gateway
Transport
jsonrpc-request
Trigger
Mint a live session (agent builds after the reply); a DB row appears on the first prompt unless seeded.
Schema fidelity
{"payload":"exact","result":"exact","carrier":"structural","limitations":["Contract models are enforced at dispatch for unknown params keys only; production logs, rather than rejects, a result or payload that violates its model, so runtime captures remain the occurrence authority.","OpenModel payloads (additionalProperties true) admit producer-owned fields that the contract does not enumerate.","Contract declarations establish legal shape and existence, not runtime reachability.","The carrier is the JSON-RPC frame as the stdio census records it; the census marks its own outbound frames with direction \"client\"."]}

Channel
tui-gateway
Transport
jsonrpc-request
Trigger
Attach to a stored session: reuse it if live here, else lazy / deferred / cold / eager rebuild.
Schema fidelity
{"payload":"exact","result":"exact","carrier":"structural","limitations":["Contract models are enforced at dispatch for unknown params keys only; production logs, rather than rejects, a result or payload that violates its model, so runtime captures remain the occurrence authority.","OpenModel payloads (additionalProperties true) admit producer-owned fields that the contract does not enumerate.","Contract declarations establish legal shape and existence, not runtime reachability.","The carrier is the JSON-RPC frame as the stdio census records it; the census marks its own outbound frames with direction \"client\"."]}

The contract admits no cwd: unlike 0.20.0, which ignored an unread cwd, the dispatcher rejects any undeclared key with error 4000 (captured in resume-turn).
